lane: مَضْحَلٌ The _place of a_ ضَحْل: (M, TA:) or _a place in which is little water:_ (O, K:) the mirage (سَرَاب) is likened thereto: (TA:) pl. مَضَاحِلُ; (O, TA;) to which Ru-beh, (O,) or El-'Ajjáj, (TA,) likens clouds. (O, * TA.)
